card.name: Just before the word use or therapy
card.fires_on: The end of NSAID inside the phrase NSAID therapy, and the word the or sequential right before use or coadministration of a drug. It fires where a drug's use is about to be named.

modes.label: NSAID split
modes.description: The ID ending of NSAID right before the word therapy.
modes.example: However, even short-term NSA<<ID>> therapy is not without risk.

modes.label: The before use
modes.description: The word the after a verb such as avoid, including or considering, right before use or coadministration.
modes.example: Physiologic or pharmacologic induction of labor, including<< the>> use of CERVIDIL, is

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word application and raises words meaning using or uses, so the next word is more likely to be use.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to say use of a drug, such as the use of or NSAID therapy.
